description: This file defines the ServerRequestInterface interface within the PSR-7 HTTP message standard, describing the structure and behavior of server-side HTTP request objects, including methods for accessing server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, parsed body, and request attributes.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Retrieve server parameters related to the incoming request environment, typically mirroring PHP's $_SERVER superglobal.

methods.name: getCookieParams
methods.description: Retrieve cookies sent by the client, compatible with $_COOKIE.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified cookies, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified query string arguments.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Retrieve uploaded files metadata in a normalized structure, possibly as UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified uploaded files, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Retrieve deserialized body parameters, such as $_POST data or parsed content.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified parsed body data.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieve application-specific attributes derived from the request.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieve a specific attribute with optional default if not set.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Return a new instance with a specified attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Return a new instance with a specified attribute removed.
